latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Shopify/DTC Brand Protection skill.

- Detects counterfeit stores, unauthorized resellers, and trademark violations.
- Monitors domains and social media for brand misuse.
- Includes DMCA takedown, cease & desist, and platform report templates.
- No API key required; customizable input for your brand.
- Provides actionable risk levels and response workflow for infringements.
